mapper.select: SELECT id, account_number, user_id, account_type, balance, status, created_at FROM accounts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, account_number, user_id, account_type, balance, status, created_at FROM accounts WHERE account_number = #{accountNumber}
SELECT id, account_number, user_id, account_type, balance, status, created_at FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (account_number, user_id, account_type, balance, status) VALUES (#{accountNumber}, #{userId}, #{accountType}, #{balance}, #{status})
